fields.description: Omit the specified clay facing brick to the east elevation and substitute buff engineering brick, approx. 140 m2, following the planning condition discharge dated 28/01/2026.

description: Omit the specified clay facing brick to the east elevation and substitute buff engineering brick, approx. 140 m2

why: 04/02/2026 alone reads two ways, but 28/01/2026 and 13/02/2026 can only be day first, so this document writes day first: 4 February. A variation order is the same instrument under its British name. The work omits one brick and the price still rises.
